notes: Capy Castaway sand is near-yellow; the shadow goes mauve, not grey. gradientBase/gradientHeight are OBJECT space and this geometry is unit-sized: metre-scale values here saturate the sweep to a constant and switch the vertical gradient off entirely, which is how every instanced asset in the greybox lost it. Brush params re-authored once the LOD ladder gained a floor (see `lod` in painterly.ts): with `.max(0)` clamping the ladder at the authored world scale, a 5 m mark period on a 10 m block meant ZERO variation across a 200 px facet, and a 60x60 patch inside the nearest cliff face in lagoon-morning.png measured luma std 0.009 against 0.096 in the cliff interior of refs/painterly/cliffs-tohad.jpg. The terrain's own brushStrength (meadow 1.45) was carrying the structure gate while every instanced prop rode for free.
